description: Header file defining utility functions for JSON parsing, configuration finding, and launching a CVD parser tester within the 'cuttlefish' namespace, along with associated include directives.

methods.name: ParseJsonString
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a Json::Value object.

methods.name: FindConfig
methods.description: Finds the presence of an element in a vector of strings.

methods.name: FindConfigIgnoreSpaces
methods.description: Finds an element in a vector of strings, ignoring spaces.

methods.name: LaunchCvdParserTester
methods.description: Launches a tester for the CVD parser with a given JSON configuration, returning a Result encapsulating a vector of strings.
